fact: NotreAfrik states that Gabon became the sixteenth state to ratify the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention) in 2026, in an article counting 16 ratifications of 55 African Union member states; the article gives no date within 2026 and no deposit.

The African Union Commission's status list of 2 February 2026 shows Gabon with no date of signature, ratification or accession, or deposit for the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection, which entered into force on 8 June 2023; the list records 21 signatures, 20 ratifications and 20 deposits among 55 states.
ACTPOL, citing the African Union status list of 2 February 2026, says Gabon has taken no action on the Malabo Convention.
